changelog:
Initial public release of SwarmClaw multi-agent orchestration skill.

- Reworked skill documentation with a full overview of system components, architecture diagram, agent types, capabilities, and security features.
- Split documentation into specialized SKILL.md files under Agents/ and Communication/ for better modularity.
- Added pricing tiers, revenue metrics, and buyer audience sections.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md and previous SKILL.md in favor of more detailed platform and usage instructions.
- Provided references to key config files and scripts, plus a step-by-step quick start guide.
summary: Coordinate multiple AI agents to parallelize tasks, manage communication, aggregate results, and optimize revenue across your agent fleet.
